items.title: # Write Welcome Letter
items.content: Draft a warm welcome email for a new [Job Title] joining [Company Name]. Include info on their start date, manager, and first day instructions. Emphasize team support.

items.title: # Summarize Company Culture
items.content: Create a brief overview of our company culture at [Company Name]. Highlight our core values: [Value 1], [Value 2], [Value 3]. Explain what new hires can expect.

items.title: # Generate First-Day Checklist
items.content: Generate a comprehensive checklist for a new employee's first day as a [Job Title]. Include items like meeting the team, setting up equipment, and essential HR paperwork.

items.title: # Explain Employee Benefits
items.content: Explain our company's key employee benefits (health insurance, PTO, 401k, professional development) in simple, easy-to-understand language for new hires.

items.content: Create an inclusive job description for a [Job Title]. Ensure the language is gender-neutral and bias-free, appealing to a diverse pool of candidates. Emphasize growth opportunities and team culture.

items.title: # Remote Role Outline
items.content: Generate a remote job description for a [Job Title]. Specify expectations for remote work, necessary tools, communication methods, and any time zone requirements. Highlight benefits of remote

items.title: # Outcome Based Description
items.content: Develop a performance-based job description for a [Job Title]. Focus on the key outcomes and achievements expected in the first 30, 60, and 90 days, rather than just tasks. Use action verbs.

items.title: # Simplify Legal Jargon
items.content: Explain this rental agreement in simple terms, highlighting any clauses that might be confusing for a first-time renter. [Paste agreement text here]

items.title: # Spot Hidden Fees
items.content: Review this rental agreement specifically for any hidden fees, unusual charges, or unexpected costs. List them clearly. [Paste agreement text here]

items.title: # Summarize Key Clauses

items.title: # Clarify Maintenance Rules
items.content: Extract all information regarding maintenance responsibilities (tenant vs. landlord) and repair procedures from this rental agreement. [Paste agreement text here]

items.title: # General Tax Prep
items.content: Create a comprehensive tax filing checklist for individuals in [Country] for the [Year] tax season. Include key documents, deadlines, and essential steps.

items.title: # Freelancer Tax List
items.content: Generate a tax preparation checklist specifically for freelance or gig workers in [Country] for [Year], focusing on income tracking, business expenses, and estimated taxes.

items.title: # Maximize Tax Deductions
items.content: List common tax deductions and credits available for [Individuals/Families/Small Businesses] in [Country] for the [Year] tax year. Provide brief explanations for each.

items.title: # Organize Tax Documents
items.content: Provide a step-by-step guide on how to organize tax documents for easy filing and record-keeping for [Year]. Suggest both digital and physical organization methods.

items.title: # Compare Policy Features

items.title: # Explain Policy Terms
items.content: Explain the following terms from my [Type of Insurance] policy in simple language for a beginner: [List terms, e.g., deductible, premium, rider, co-insurance].

items.title: # Analyze Policy Value
items.content: Analyze the value of [Policy Name/Type] based on its monthly premium of [Amount] and coverage limits for [Specific Risks]. Is it a good deal for [My Situation]?

items.title: # Select Eco-Friendly Materials
items.content: Recommend [number] eco-friendly and durable material options for [Specific area, e.g., bathroom flooring] suitable for a [Style, e.g., minimalist] design. List pros and cons for each suggestion.

items.title: # Compare Car Models
items.content: Compare [Car Model 1] vs. [Car Model 2]. Focus on [safety features, fuel efficiency, tech, reliability]. Provide pros and cons for each and a recommendation for a [family, commuter, enthusiast].

items.title: # Budget Car Finder
items.content: I need car recommendations under $[Budget] that are [new/used]. My priorities are [fuel economy, cargo space, AWD, low maintenance]. List 3 options with key specs and why they fit.

items.title: # Understand Car Features
items.content: Explain [feature name, e.g., 'adaptive cruise control', 'CVT transmission'] in simple terms. How does it work, what are its benefits, and are there any downsides? Give a real-world example.

items.title: # Negotiate Car Deal
items.content: I'm buying a [Car Model, Year] with [Mileage, Trim]. What are common negotiation tactics for dealers? What fair price range should I aim for, and what questions should I ask before signing?
